decisions.reason: The negative-eigenvalue sets are well-defined independently of error syndromes, but the Definition incorrectly attributes a check-eigenvalue convention to a supplier defining Pauli commutation bits. Corrected that nonfatal attribution and proved g(Eφ)=(-1)^s Eφ for gφ=φ and Eg=(-1)^s gE; no realizability claim for arbitrary eigenvectors is needed.

False positive: the actual F4 supplier Statement expressly gives 0 at every other star or plaquette, and Proof 1.1–1.2 proves same-species commutation. Thus a one-edge Z applied to a code vector has (Ne,Nm)=(2,0), and a one-edge X has (0,2); unitarity preserves nonzeroness. Joint-sector decomposition and even parities give the lower bound, attained at 4 min(Je,Jm), including equal couplings. The shortened F4 summary does not remove the cited full conclusion.

False positive: the supplier Proof 1.1 identifies Z on the primal trail support, and 1.2 explicitly identifies a dual edge with the crossed primal edge carrying its qubit. These specify the string operators used in its Statement; the eigenvalue syndrome conclusion is not being used to reconstruct support. With one shared physical qubit the pure Z/X labels have symplectic pairing 1, so the cited commutator theorem proves the sign. No dynamics or statistics experiment is inferred.

False positive: the periodic toric code is the family defined from def-qc-tqc-periodic-square-cellulation, whose Definition fixes an integer L≥3; def-qc-tqc-toric-checks uses precisely that cellulation. Recovery does not define or quantify over an alternative L=1 or L=2 code. Its contract likewise explicitly excludes L<3. Within this inherited domain the dimension theorem gives a nonzero stabilizer code, d(S)=L, and 2t<L is exactly the finite-channel correction hypothesis, including t=0.

False positive: the published planar supplier Proof 6.2 constructs a straight top-to-bottom dual normalizer path and proves it nontrivial by odd intersection with the Z row; 7.1 explicitly proves that it attains weight d+1. Thus F2 accurately reports a conclusion proved in the cited item even though its Statement advertises only the lower bound. At d=3 the weights are (3,4); the toric lower bound and nontrivial three-edge pure X/Z loops give (3,3), with one versus two encoded qubits. No published repair is necessary.
